Hi, 
You are trying to load a csv file with load(). load() is for .RData files, not csv. Use read.csv() instead.
Best regards,
Jürgen

messages.subject: Re: [camtrapR] Re: Socio-economic assessment
parts:
Please use read.csv() instead of load():

read.csv("~/Data Analysis/Data_ALL.csv")

and make sure you setwd() correctly.

Like I said, you have a csv file, and load() does not work on csv files (load is only for .RData files).

Best,

Jürgen
